title: Contents Packout & Storage Lined Vault Standard for Contaminated Water Contents
content:
Contents Packout & Storage contents from a contaminated water loss are kept in lined vaults. On a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job whose vault storage is billed to the customer, **when the job's linked mitigation job is a company water job assessed category 3, the tier's vault rate carries the black-water lining percentage; when that water job is assessed category 2, the tier's vault rate carries the gray-water lining percentage; when the linked mitigation job is a water job assessed category 1, is not a water job, or there is none, no lining percentage applies.**

## Lining percentages

| Linked mitigation job | Water category assessed on that Water Damage Mitigation job | Lining percentage carried by the vault rate |
|---|---|---|
| a company water job | category 3 (black water) | 12 percent (black-water lining percentage) |
| a company water job | category 2 (gray water) | 6 percent (gray-water lining percentage) |
| a company water job | category 1 | none |
| a job that is not a water job | — | none |
| no linked mitigation job | — | none |

The category read is the water category recorded on the Water Damage Mitigation job that the contents job names as its linked mitigation job.

## Points of judgement

- **Which record decides.** Only the water category assessed on the linked company water job counts; a category described by the customer but not recorded on that job does not.
- **What the percentage applies to.** The lining percentage is carried by the tier's vault rate, per vault.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a vault rate taken as 100.00 for the illustration, a category 3 linked water job brings the rate to 112.00 per vault and a category 2 linked water job to 106.00 per vault.
